::: {#sol-why-layers}

A second layer can build [features](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature) out of features.
A first layer might respond to short strokes in particular places;
a second can combine strokes into loops, corners and lines;
and the output layer can combine those into digits.
Each layer describes the image in larger parts than the layer before it
[@goodfellow2016deep, Ch. 1].

:::
